scenarios.desc: Mixed security and style comments on one PR
scenarios.input: PR 908 has review comments from coderabbitai[bot], a human, and cursor[bot]. One is a style naming nit from the human and one is a CWE-78 injection note from coderabbitai[bot]. Address the review feedback on this PR. What order do you process them in and how is each one closed? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Processing Order sorts by domain first (P0 Security, P1 Bug, P2 Style) and breaks ties by reviewer priority, so a coderabbitai security comment precedes a human style comment. Obligations require a terminal status per thread.

scenarios.desc: Many threads that share one root cause
scenarios.input: Respond to PR comments on PR 1897. There are 17 unresolved threads and about 8 of them restate the same framing on different files. Patching file by file has not worked for two rounds. What do you do first? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Phase 0 runs scripts/cluster_threads.py and, when a cluster of 4 or more threads is reported, stops the per-thread loop and fixes the framing in the source artifact first.

scenarios.input: Reply to reviewer on PR 908: I fixed a bot thread and pushed commit abc1234. In what order do I react, reply, resolve and record status, and which threads am I allowed to resolve? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Obligations, Mutation order: react with eyes before analysis, reply in-thread, push the fix, post the reply with the commit SHA, resolve, then record status through Gate 3. Only bot-authored or explicitly approved threads are resolved.

scenarios.desc: Run local pre-push quality gates instead of working PR review threads (negative)
scenarios.input: Run the six local PR quality gates (security, QA, analyst, architect, DevOps, roadmap) against my uncommitted working tree before I push. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The description says Do NOT use to run the local quality gates before pushing (use pr-quality). Running local pre-push axes does not work PR review threads.

scenarios.input: Reviewer asked why I used a set on line 40 of PR 908. I already know the answer: it dedupes ids. Just post that single reply to that one comment. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The description and When to Use say to use post_pr_comment_reply.py directly for a single known reply with no triage needed.
